userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for config focus area
userStories.notes: Generated 11 stories (US-80-002 through US-80-012) targeting config management and validation improvements. Stories cover: provider validation sync, _convert_nested_configs completeness, unknown field warnings, context enrichment validation, validate() coverage for new sections, config diff utility, effective config export, config merge re-validation, config load error DX, config section validation test coverage, and config freeze after load.

userStories.title: Sync embedding provider validation between base.py and core.py
acceptanceCriteria: base.py _validate_enums() uses the same provider set as EmbeddingConfig.KNOWN_PROVIDERS from core.py instead of a hardcoded set
Adding a new provider to KNOWN_PROVIDERS in core.py automatically includes it in base.py validation
The 'ollama' provider no longer triggers a spurious validation error in validate()
Test: validate() returns no embedding provider error when provider='ollama'
Test: validate() still returns error for truly unknown providers like 'nonexistent'
userStories.notes: Fixed: replaced hardcoded valid_providers set in base.py _validate_enums() with EmbeddingConfig.KNOWN_PROVIDERS from core.py. Added 'ollama' to parametrized valid provider test. Both valid and invalid provider tests pass.

userStories.title: Extend _convert_nested_configs to handle all section dataclasses
acceptanceCriteria: _convert_nested_configs() converts all section fields that are dicts to their dataclass types, not just healing
After merge_config() mutates a section to a dict, _convert_nested_configs() correctly restores it to the proper dataclass
Test: config with matching section as raw dict is correctly converted to MatchingConfig after _convert_nested_configs()
Test: config with download section as raw dict is correctly converted to DownloadConfig
Test: already-converted dataclass sections are left unchanged (idempotent)
userStories.notes: Fixed: _convert_nested_configs() now iterates all Config dataclass fields using default_factory + is_dataclass to generically convert dicts to proper types. Handles `from __future__ import annotations` (string types) by using default_factory instead of field.type. 5 new tests: matching dict, download dict, healing dict, already-converted unchanged, idempotent double-call. All 269 section validation tests pass.

userStories.title: Warn on unknown YAML keys in critical config sections
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown keys in critical sections (download, matching, output, etc.) produce a WARNING-level log, not just debug
Unknown keys in optional sections remain at debug level
Test: loading config with unknown key 'matching.foo_bar' logs at WARNING level
Test: loading config with unknown key 'broll.foo_bar' logs at DEBUG level only
The warning message includes the section name, unknown key, and suggests the closest valid field name if one exists within edit distance 2
userStories.notes: Fixed: Added `import difflib` to base.py. Modified `_build_dataclass` unknown key handling so critical sections (download, matching, output, etc.) log WARNING with typo suggestions via `difflib.get_close_matches`, while optional sections remain at DEBUG level. Added 5 tests in TestUnknownKeyWarnings class covering all acceptance criteria: WARNING for critical section unknown keys, DEBUG for optional section unknown keys, typo suggestion in warning message, no warning for valid keys, and correct suggestion for close matches. All 40 tests in the file pass.

userStories.title: Add __post_init__ validation to ContextEnrichmentConfig
acceptanceCriteria: ContextEnrichmentConfig.__post_init__ validates max_description_length >= 0 and raises ValueError if negative
ContextEnrichmentConfig.__post_init__ clamps max_description_length to 10000 with warning if exceeding reasonable limit
ChapterGroupingConfig.__post_init__ validates relevance_boost_weight is 0.0-1.0
ChapterGroupingConfig.__post_init__ validates coherence_penalty_threshold >= 1
Test: ContextEnrichmentConfig(max_description_length=-1) raises ValueError
Test: ChapterGroupingConfig(relevance_boost_weight=2.0) clamps to 1.0 with warning
userStories.notes: Added __post_init__ to ContextEnrichmentConfig (ValueError for negative max_description_length, warn+clamp at 10000) and ChapterGroupingConfig (ValueError for coherence_penalty_threshold < 1 and negative relevance_boost_weight, warn+clamp relevance_boost_weight at 1.0). 12 tests pass.

userStories.title: Extend validate() to cover context_enrichment and chapter_grouping constraints
acceptanceCriteria: validate() checks that chapter_grouping.chapter_topic_match_boost is a list of exactly 2 floats [min, max] with min <= max
validate() checks that chapter_grouping.chapter_topic_mismatch_penalty is negative (it's a penalty)
validate() checks that context_enrichment.max_description_length is positive
validate() checks cross-section constraint: if context_enrichment.title_enriched_embeddings is true, embedding provider must be configured
Test: validate() returns error when chapter_topic_match_boost=[0.10, 0.05] (min > max)
userStories.notes: Added chapter_topic_match_boost and chapter_topic_mismatch_penalty fields to ChapterGroupingConfig. Extended _validate_constraints() with 5 checks: boost list validation, mismatch penalty negativity, max_description_length positivity, cross-section title_enriched_embeddings/provider check. 14 tests pass.

userStories.title: Add config diff utility to compare two Config instances
acceptanceCriteria: New function config_diff(config_a, config_b) in src/config/utils.py returns dict of differences
Diff output includes field path (e.g., 'matching.min_confidence'), old value, and new value
Nested dataclass fields are recursively compared
Fields with equal values are excluded from the diff
Test: diff between default config and config with matching.min_confidence=0.8 shows only that field
Test: diff between identical configs returns empty dict
userStories.notes: Added config_diff() to src/config/utils.py with recursive dataclass comparison. Skips private _fields. 9 tests in test_config_diff_us80_007.py all passing.

userStories.title: Add effective config export to YAML
acceptanceCriteria: New method Config.to_dict() returns config as nested dict suitable for YAML serialization
New method Config.to_yaml(path) writes the effective config to a YAML file
Exported YAML can be loaded back with from_yaml() and produce an equivalent config (roundtrip)
Sensitive fields (api_keys) are redacted in the export by default, with option to include them
Test: config roundtrip through to_yaml/from_yaml preserves all non-sensitive field values
userStories.notes: Replaced incomplete private _to_dict/to_yaml with public to_dict(redact_sensitive=True) and to_yaml(path, redact_sensitive=True). to_dict() includes all section_mapping entries + duration_tiers with YAML-style keys. API keys redacted by default. 16 tests in test_config_export_yaml.py covering to_dict completeness, redaction, to_yaml file write, and full roundtrip (export->from_yaml->compare).

userStories.title: Re-run validate() after merge_config to catch invalid overrides
acceptanceCriteria: merge_config() calls config.validate() after applying overrides and logs any new validation errors at WARNING level
Invalid overrides (e.g., matching.min_confidence=2.0) produce a clear warning during merge, not a silent misconfiguration
merge_config() does NOT raise on validation warnings (non-breaking), only logs them
Test: merge_config with override matching.min_confidence=2.0 logs a warning about value > 1.0
Test: merge_config with valid overrides produces no validation warnings
userStories.notes: All 5/5 criteria verified. Implementation in config_utils.py:331-333, tests in test_merge_config_validates_us80_009.py (4 tests pass).

userStories.title: Improve config loading error messages with YAML location context
acceptanceCriteria: When a YAML parsing error occurs, the error message includes the line number and column from the YAML file
When _build_dataclass fails for a critical section, the error message includes which YAML keys were unexpected
When a TypeError occurs during dataclass construction, the message suggests the correct field name if a close match exists
Test: loading a config with invalid YAML syntax raises ConfigError with line number in message
Test: loading a config with wrong field type (e.g., matching.min_confidence='abc') includes the field name and expected type
userStories.notes: Tier: DX improvement. Source: src/config/base.py lines 337-370 (from_yaml) and lines 458-531 (_build_dataclass). Currently YAML parse errors surface raw yaml.YAMLError which can be cryptic. TypeError from dataclass construction shows the raw Python error. Wrap both with user-friendly messages.

userStories.title: Add config freeze mechanism to prevent mutation after pipeline start
acceptanceCriteria: New method Config.freeze() marks config as immutable by setting an internal _frozen flag
After freeze(), any __setattr__ on Config or its section dataclasses raises FrozenConfigError
Pipeline.run() calls config.freeze() before entering the first stage
Config.unfreeze() method exists for test scenarios that need mutation
Test: setting config.matching.min_confidence after freeze() raises FrozenConfigError
Test: config before freeze() allows normal attribute setting
userStories.notes: Tier: safety/architecture. Source: src/config/base.py (Config class) and src/pipeline.py (Pipeline.run). Currently config is mutable throughout pipeline execution, which can cause subtle bugs if a stage modifies config that downstream stages depend on. Use __setattr__ override with _frozen check. FrozenConfigError subclass of ConfigError.
